observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon DSLR body with 'Canon' branding and 'EOS 5D' and 'Mark II' markings on the front/right area.
Photo 1 shows the rear of the camera with an LCD screen and Canon controls; no clear screen content is readable.
Photo 2 shows the bottom label with 'Canon' and 'DS126201' and other regulatory text; serial number appears but is not fully verifiable from the image quality.

claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 21.1-megapixel sensor...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos show the camera body but do not confirm sensor megapixels or full-frame specs.

risks.risk: Shutter count / wear level unknown; could be high and affect value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera showing shutter count (or a service report / shutter count app result).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case wear (assume higher shutter count) for a used body.

risks.risk: LCD screen condition unknown (dead pixels, lines, brightness issues).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the LCD displaying menus and a live view image (no glare), plus a close-up of the screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the LCD may be imperfect (worst-case for display).

risks.risk: Autofocus performance unknown (AF may be weak or inconsistent).
risks.proof: A short video showing AF tracking in live view and through the viewfinder on a moving subject, plus a focus confirmation shot.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working AF (worst-case).

risks.proof: A test shot of a blank wall/sky at high f-stop (e.g., f/16-f/22) and a close-up crop showing dust/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if sensor may need cleaning (worst-case).

risks.risk: Mount/contacts and battery door/ports condition unknown (corrosion, loose mount, missing parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens mount contacts and the battery compartment/door, plus port area (USB/AV) if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if there may be minor issues with contacts/doors (worst-case).

proof_requests: Send a photo of the camera powered on showing the menu screen and battery level.
Send a clear close-up of the lens mount and the battery compartment/door.
Provide a shutter count screenshot (or service report) for EOS 5D Mark II.
Provide a sensor dust test shot (blank wall/sky at high f-stop) with a crop.
response.reason: The photos clearly identify the camera as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II, but key condition factors that drive Lagos second-hand pricing (shutter count, LCD/sensor/AF health) are not verifiable from the provided images.
